experiment_data.hypothesis: Detach OCC head with BN (same seed=42) retrain for gradient analysis: detaching OCC gradients from the backbone isolates occupancy learning effects, enabling same-seed 4-condition gradient comparison to quantify OCC head's backward contribution to VLA features.
